| Role | Action | Counteraction | Notes |
|------|--------|---------------|-------|
| **Duke** | **Tax** – take 3 coins (**[tax]**) | Blocks **[foreign aid]** | Pure economy  |

| **Contessa** | — | Blocks **[assassinate]** | Purely defensive  |
